say:0:1110134001:0.text: Strange... why is an abandoned carriage here?
say:0:1110134001:0.source_cn: 奇怪，这里怎么被马车挡住了去路？

say:1:1110134002:0.text: There haven't been many people passing by the oasis lately. More outsiders?
say:1:1110134002:0.source_cn: 最近也没什么人在绿洲前经过，还有更多的外来者吗？

say:1:1110135002:0.text: It's a spider! It's going to eat me!
say:1:1110135002:0.source_cn: 是蜘蛛！蜘蛛要吃掉我了！

say:0:1110136001:0.text: There's a person trapped in the spider web! Soren, we have to help!
say:0:1110136001:0.source_cn: 那里有个人被蛛网困住了！索恩，我们得去帮忙！

say:1:1110137001:1.text: The Ashen Wastes sure is terrifying! It's the scariest place I've been since joining the Evergreen Conservatory...
say:1:1110137001:1.source_cn: 荒角沙漠好可怕！加入冬青学会后，我还从没来过这么危险的...

say:2:1110137002:1.text: I already regret listening to Master Ravan and joining this project...
say:2:1110137002:1.source_cn: 我已经后悔听了前辈的鬼话，加入这个课题——

say:3:1110137003:1.text: Oh, no! I said that too loudly! I'll be punished later!
say:3:1110137003:1.source_cn: 糟、糟糕，我说得太大声了！等下会被前辈揍的！

choice_prompt:4:1110137003.text: Oh, no! I said that too loudly! I'll be punished later!
choice_prompt:4:1110137003.source_cn: 糟、糟糕，我说得太大声了！等下会被前辈揍的！

say:5:1110137004:1.text: Huh? Master Ravan! Where could he be? Why did he leave me all alone?
say:5:1110137004:1.source_cn: 诶？前辈——！前辈你在哪里！为什么留下我一个人啊！

say:6:1110137005:1.text: I heard countless stories about how easy it is to lose your way here! Could he be lost?!
say:6:1110137005:1.source_cn: 来之前我就听说，这片沙漠特别容易迷路！难道、难道前辈迷路了？

say:7:1110137006:1.text: No, I need to find him. There shouldn't be any other giant spiders around, right?
say:7:1110137006:1.source_cn: 不行，我要去找前辈！这片沙漠里应该没有别的蜘蛛了吧？

say:9:1110137007:1.text: There may be, and there are many other beasts as well.
say:9:1110137007:1.source_cn: 蜘蛛有可能，别的野兽也不少。

say:10:1110137008:1.text: You might not be able to tell, but I'm terrified of spiders.
say:10:1110137008:1.source_cn: 呃！腿软了！诸位可能看不出来，不过我其实最怕蜘蛛了……

choice_prompt:11:1110137008.text: You might not be able to tell, but I'm terrified of spiders.
choice_prompt:11:1110137008.source_cn: 呃！腿软了！诸位可能看不出来，不过我其实最怕蜘蛛了……

say:13:1110137009:1.text: Don't you worry! We'll protect you and help find Master Ravan!
say:13:1110137009:1.source_cn: 看出来了，不过你别担心！我们会保护着你，去找到你的前辈的！

say:14:1110137011:1.text: We'll help you find him. The Sunseek Arena isn't that far away. Let's go in that direction.
say:14:1110137011:1.source_cn: 找人的事就包在我们身上——没关系，去残阳武斗场的路不远...
say:14:1110137011:1.male: We'll help you find him. The Sunseek Arena isn't that far away. Let's go in that direction.
say:14:1110137011:1.female: We'll help you find him. The Sunseek Arena isn't that far away. Let's go in that direction.

say:15:1110137012:1.text: Alsa, you're taking on too much again... Alright, let's go.
say:15:1110137012:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨，你又在把事情往身上揽——算了。速战速决吧。

say:16:1110137013:1.text: We can't just leave him and his master to fend for themselves.
say:16:1110137013:1.source_cn: 我们难道能放着他不管吗？

say:17:1110137014:1.source_cn: 我看不出来为什么不行。

say:18:1110137015:1.text: I won't stand by and watch someone get hurt on the land of the Uru Clan!
say:18:1110137015:1.source_cn: 我可不能眼睁睁地看着，有人在乌尔氏族的附近出事！

say:22:1110137010:0.text: I was going to say the same thing, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:22:1110137010:0.male: I was going to say the same thing, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.
say:22:1110137010:0.female: I was going to say the same thing, <style="stress"><player_name></style>.

choice:4:0:1.text: I don't see your Master Ravan...
choice:4:0:1.male: I don't see your Master Ravan...
choice:4:0:1.female: I don't see your Master Ravan...

say:0:1110150001:0.source_cn: 笨、笨蛋满满！那、那是什么？

say:1:1110150002:0.text: It looks like a scary spider!

say:0:1110201001:0.text: Is that a person over there?!

say:1:1110201002:0.text: Good job spotting him, Chippy! That person is dressed like the scholar we saved just now...
say:1:1110201002:0.source_cn: 满满，好眼力！这个人和刚刚被困的人穿着打扮也很相似——

say:1:1110203001:1.text: Does this symbol mean <style="highlight">strength</style>? And the scene here seems to describe a gathering of some sort...

say:2:1110203002:1.text: <style="highlight">Blood</style>... If only there were a Mauler here to help me identify this...

say:3:1110203003:1.text: Hi! Are you a scholar from the Evergreen Conservatory? I'm Alsa.
say:3:1110203003:1.source_cn: 嗨！是冬青学会的学者吗？我是阿尔萨。

choice_prompt:4:1110203003.text: Hi! Are you a scholar from the Evergreen Conservatory? I'm Alsa.
choice_prompt:4:1110203003.source_cn: 嗨！是冬青学会的学者吗？我是阿尔萨。

say:5:1110203004:1.text: Master Ravan! I'm so glad that you're alright.
say:5:1110203004:1.source_cn: 前辈，你没事真的是太好——

say:6:1110203005:1.text: Miss, are you a Mauler from around these parts? I have some questions I would like to ask...
say:6:1110203005:1.source_cn: 哦哦！阿尔萨，你是本地蛮血吧？我有事情请你——

say:7:1110203006:1.text: Master! I just escaped from the fangs of a spider! And you don't even care!
say:7:1110203006:1.source_cn: 前辈，我可是刚刚从蜘蛛口中逃生……都不关心我一句的吗！

say:8:1110203007:1.text: That's not important! You two, this is a once-in-a-lifetime request. Can you help me read this tablet and translate its contents?
say:8:1110203007:1.source_cn: 那种事情不重要！两位，这是我此生仅此一次的请求——能帮...

say:11:1110203009:1.text: Soren, didn't you hear what he just said? This is a once-in-a-lifetime request! We have to help him!
say:11:1110203009:1.source_cn: 索恩，你听到了吗？这是人家一生仅一次的请求，我们怎么能...

say:12:1110203010:1.text: ... I guess we should help him then. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Alsa, let's take a look at these stone tablets.
say:12:1110203010:1.male: ... I guess we should help him then. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Alsa, let's take a look at these stone tablets.
say:12:1110203010:1.female: ... I guess we should help him then. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Alsa, let's take a look at these stone tablets.

say:0:1110204001:0.text: Master Ravan, is there anything I can do to help?
say:0:1110204001:0.source_cn: 前辈，有没有什么我能帮上——

say:1:1110204002:0.text: Has there been any progress? The stone tablet must contain the legend of the Dusk Lord and the setting sun, does it not?
say:1:1110204002:0.source_cn: 两位，有进展了吗？石碑上是残阳神的传说，没错吧？

say:2:1110204003:0.text: "Acquire the ultimate honor, offer the blood of kin, and gain proof of the setting sun."
say:2:1110204003:0.source_cn: “获至强之誉，献同源之血，得残阳之证。”

say:3:1110204004:0.source_cn: ——这块石碑上的字符，按你们的话说应该是这个意思。

say:1:1110205001:1.text: "Acquire the ultimate honor, the blood of kin, and receive proof of the setting sun." So this is the legend of the Dusk Lord and the setting sun.

say:2:1110205002:1.text: This is fascinating beyond measure. I wonder what the meaning behind this phrase is.
say:2:1110205002:1.source_cn: 真是有趣，不知道背后代表了什么意义？

say:3:1110205003:1.text: Really? Do outlanders not know about this legend?
say:3:1110205003:1.source_cn: 咦？难道对沙漠外的人来说，这个传说的意义还有什么不明白...

say:4:1110205004:1.text: Every Mauler child knows that to gain the <style="highlight">ultimate honor</style> is to become the winner of the Warsong Festival.
say:4:1110205004:1.source_cn: 在沙漠里即使小孩也知道——<style=highlig...

say:5:1110205005:1.text: <style="highlight">Blood of kin</style> means the blood of your family, and <style="highlight">proof of the setting sun</style> refers to an ancient weapon wielded by the primordial warlord...

say:6:1110205006:1.text: So the legend implies that after becoming the winner of the Warsong Festival and offering up the blood of a family member, you will receive an ancient weapon?
say:6:1110205006:1.source_cn: 所以传说的意思是——成为战歌节的胜者后，再献上血亲的血...

say:7:1110205007:1.text: Or does it actually mean sacrificing a family member to obtain this ancient weapon to become the ultimate warrior?
say:7:1110205007:1.source_cn: 或者意思其实是，只有献上血亲的血，得到战神武器后，才能...

choice_prompt:8:1110205007.text: Or does it actually mean sacrificing a family member to obtain this ancient weapon to become the ultimate warrior?
choice_prompt:8:1110205007.source_cn: 或者意思其实是，只有献上血亲的血，得到战神武器后，才能成为真正的至强者？

say:9:1110205008:1.text: We Maulers are a race that values strength above everything else, after all. Even our god often shows us his harsher side.
say:9:1110205008:1.source_cn: 对不住啦！毕竟蛮血是最崇尚力量的种族，连我们的神也有残...

say:10:1110205009:1.text: Oh, since we're about done here, how about we head off?
say:10:1110205009:1.source_cn: 对了，这里是不是没什么我们能帮上忙的事了？那我们就出发啦！

say:11:1110205010:1.text: Farewell! Thank you for your help! Not only did you help me read the symbols, but you also saved my favorite research assistant.
say:11:1110205010:1.source_cn: 再见啦！多谢你们的帮忙！不仅帮我识读石碑，还救了我最喜...

say:12:1110205011:1.text: Me? Your favorite? That's so nice!
say:12:1110205011:1.source_cn: 呃？最喜欢的后辈？我、我吗？好感动！

say:0:1110206001:0.text: The ancient weapon wielded by the primordial warlord... Chippy wonders if it's powerful!
say:0:1110206001:0.source_cn: 初代战神的武器……是不是很厉害？

say:3:1110206004:0.text: The legend doesn't go into so much detail.
say:3:1110206004:0.source_cn: 我不知道也很正常吧。传说里又没说得那么详细。

say:0:1110207001:0.text: Does no one want to get this "ancient weapon"?
say:0:1110207001:0.source_cn: 就没有人想要拿到初代战神的武器吗？

say:1:1110207002:0.text: It doesn't matter. A true warrior doesn't need outside help. Brutus didn't need it.
say:1:1110207002:0.source_cn: 这不重要。真正的战士，无需外力辅助。布鲁特斯大人就没有...

say:2:1110207003:0.text: And he's the strongest warrior among the Mauler clans. Everyone aspires to be like him.
say:2:1110207003:0.source_cn: 但他仍然是蛮血最强的男人，没有人不想成为他那样的强者。

say:0:1110208001:0.text: The Sunseek Arena is just ahead!
say:0:1110208001:0.source_cn: 残阳武斗场，就在前面了！

say:1:1110208002:0.text: Yes, let's go find that fake Mer...! Mermaid! Chippy heard there was a fake mermaid!
say:1:1110208002:0.source_cn: 我们快去打探消息吧！关于那个假梅——唔唔！
say:1:1110208002:0.male: Yes, let's go find that fake Mer...! Mermaid! Chippy heard there was a fake mermaid!
say:1:1110208002:0.female: Yes, let's go find that fake Mer...! Mermaid! Chippy heard there was a fake mermaid!

say:2:1110208003:0.text: If you're looking for info, you should check out the betting house in the arena. The owner's well-informed.
say:2:1110208003:0.source_cn: 武斗场的赌场老板消息比较灵通，你们可以去找他打听！

say:3:1110208004:0.source_cn: 多谢。你们快去报名吧，稍后见。

say:1:1110209001:1.text: You look like a mage. You thinkin' about competing with our best warriors?
say:1:1110209001:1.source_cn: 看您像一个大魔法师，您要和我们蛮血的战士比拼一番吗？
say:1:1110209001:1.male: You look like a mage. You thinkin' about competing with our best warriors?
say:1:1110209001:1.female: You look like a mage. You thinkin' about competing with our best warriors?

choice_prompt:2:1110209001.text: You look like a mage. You thinkin' about competing with our best warriors?
choice_prompt:2:1110209001.source_cn: 看您像一个大魔法师，您要和我们蛮血的战士比拼一番吗？
choice_prompt:2:1110209001.male: You look like a mage. You thinkin' about competing with our best warriors?
choice_prompt:2:1110209001.female: You look like a mage. You thinkin' about competing with our best warriors?

say:3:1110209002:1.text: You must be the proprietor here. We would like some information about Magister Merlin.
say:3:1110209002:1.source_cn: 老板，我们只想打听有关于梅林的情报——
say:3:1110209002:1.male: You must be the proprietor here. We would like some information about Magister Merlin.
say:3:1110209002:1.female: You must be the proprietor here. We would like some information about Magister Merlin.

say:4:1110209003:1.text: Information has a price. How about this? You beat my boys here, and then we'll talk.
say:4:1110209003:1.source_cn: 情报也是有价格的。这样吧，只要赢过我手下的小子们，一切好说！

say:5:1110209004:1.text: Actions speak louder than words, that's the true essence of a Mauler! To all esteemed guests, here's some new entertainment!
say:5:1110209004:1.source_cn: 拳脚上动真章，才是蛮血的浪漫！走过路过的贵客们，新局已出！

say:6:1110209005:1.text: A mighty veteran fighter versus a mysterious outlander mage! Ha! What's your name?
say:6:1110209005:1.source_cn: 强悍老道的武斗场常客，对战，远道而来的神秘魔法师——您...
say:6:1110209005:1.male: A mighty veteran fighter versus a mysterious outlander mage! Ha! What's your name?
say:6:1110209005:1.female: A mighty veteran fighter versus a mysterious outlander mage! Ha! What's your name?

choice_prompt:7:1110209005.text: A mighty veteran fighter versus a mysterious outlander mage! Ha! What's your name?
choice_prompt:7:1110209005.source_cn: 强悍老道的武斗场常客，对战，远道而来的神秘魔法师——您尊姓大名？
choice_prompt:7:1110209005.male: A mighty veteran fighter versus a mysterious outlander mage! Ha! What's your name?
choice_prompt:7:1110209005.female: A mighty veteran fighter versus a mysterious outlander mage! Ha! What's your name?

say:8:1110209007:1.text: Bets here! Place your bets! Who do you think will win?!
say:8:1110209007:1.source_cn: 来来来，买定离手！诸位要买谁？

say:9:1110209008:1.text: Wait! Why are you using Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> for this?
say:9:1110209008:1.source_cn: 等等……为什么莫名其妙就要用<style=stress...
say:9:1110209008:1.male: Wait! Why are you using Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> for this?
say:9:1110209008:1.female: Wait! Why are you using Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> for this?

say:10:1110209009:1.text: Because this Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> needs information, and this is my price.
say:10:1110209009:1.male: Because this Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> needs information, and this is my price.
say:10:1110209009:1.female: Because this Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> needs information, and this is my price.

say:12:1110209006:0.text: You're funny. You don't want to use your real name. That's fine. It'll keep things mysterious.
say:12:1110209006:0.source_cn: 您真会开玩笑。没关系，匿名也能保持神秘。
say:12:1110209006:0.male: You're funny. You don't want to use your real name. That's fine. It'll keep things mysterious.
say:12:1110209006:0.female: You're funny. You don't want to use your real name. That's fine. It'll keep things mysterious.

say:0:1110210001:0.text: What a show you put on! It was completely one-sided!
say:0:1110210001:0.source_cn: 结束了！真是一场酣畅的比赛，简直是单方面碾压！

say:1:1110211001:1.text: You won fair and square. You want information on Magister Merlin, right?
say:1:1110211001:1.source_cn: 愿赌服输，您想要梅林大人的情报吗？
say:1:1110211001:1.male: You won fair and square. You want information on Magister Merlin, right?
say:1:1110211001:1.female: You won fair and square. You want information on Magister Merlin, right?

say:2:1110211002:0.text: As far as I know, he's no longer here at the Sunseek Arena.
say:2:1110211002:0.male: As far as I know, he's no longer here at the Sunseek Arena.
say:2:1110211002:0.female: As far as I know, she's no longer here at the Sunseek Arena.

say:3:1110211003:0.text: He's the special guest judge at the Warsong Festival. My guess is he's probably at Mars Peak right now.
say:3:1110211003:0.male: He's the special guest judge at the Warsong Festival. My guess is he's probably at Mars Peak right now.
say:3:1110211003:0.female: She's the special guest judge at the Warsong Festival. My guess is she's probably at Mars Peak right now.

choice_prompt:4:1110211003.text: He's the special guest judge at the Warsong Festival. My guess is he's probably at Mars Peak right now.
choice_prompt:4:1110211003.source_cn: <male>他</male><female>她</female>是战歌节的特邀裁判，多半只会出现在战神峰了吧？
choice_prompt:4:1110211003.male: He's the special guest judge at the Warsong Festival. My guess is he's probably at Mars Peak right now.
choice_prompt:4:1110211003.female: She's the special guest judge at the Warsong Festival. My guess is she's probably at Mars Peak right now.

say:5:1110211004:1.text: Only the few final warriors who move forward in the competition can reach Mars Peak. For others, it should be impossible.
say:5:1110211004:1.source_cn: 只有最终决出的几位勇士才能登顶战神峰，别的，应该没可能了。
say:5:1110211004:1.male: Only the few final warriors who move forward in the competition can reach Mars Peak. For others, it should be impossible.
say:5:1110211004:1.female: Only the few final warriors who move forward in the competition can reach Mars Peak. For others, it should be impossible.

say:6:1110211006:0.text: Normally, only the warriors who fight to the end will be able to meet him.
say:6:1110211006:0.source_cn: 一般情况下，只有决战到最后的勇士们才能见到<male>...
say:6:1110211006:0.male: Normally, only the warriors who fight to the end will be able to meet him.
say:6:1110211006:0.female: Normally, only the warriors who fight to the end will be able to meet her.

say:7:1110211007:1.text: I'm afraid it's not that easy to catch a glimpse of Magister Merlin...
say:7:1110211007:1.source_cn: 现在想一睹梅林大人的风采，恐怕没那么容易……
say:7:1110211007:1.male: I'm afraid it's not that easy to catch a glimpse of Magister Merlin...
say:7:1110211007:1.female: I'm afraid it's not that easy to catch a glimpse of Magister Merlin...

say:9:1110211005:1.text: It's hard to say. Who knows if there will be any special arrangements for the event?
say:9:1110211005:1.source_cn: 这就说不好了，谁知道赛事有没有特殊安排。
say:9:1110211005:1.male: It's hard to say. Who knows if there will be any special arrangements for the event?
say:9:1110211005:1.female: It's hard to say. Who knows if there will be any special arrangements for the event?

say:0:1110212001:0.text: It seems that we have to find a way to go to Mars Peak.
say:0:1110212001:0.source_cn: 看来，得想办法去战神峰看看了。
say:0:1110212001:0.male: It seems that we have to find a way to go to Mars Peak.
say:0:1110212001:0.female: It seems that we have to find a way to go to Mars Peak.

say:1:1110212002:0.text: I wonder if there's any other information we can get around here.
say:1:1110212002:0.source_cn: 顺便问问看，有没有别的情报吧。
say:1:1110212002:0.male: I wonder if there's any other information we can get around here.
say:1:1110212002:0.female: I wonder if there's any other information we can get around here.

say:1:1110213002:0.text: Why is the Adamant Syndicate here?
say:1:1110213002:0.source_cn: 那里有个黑金商会的，他们怎么会在这里？

say:2:1110213003:0.source_cn: 确实很奇怪，先去会一会他。

say:1:1110214001:1.text: Greetings! How can I help you?
say:1:1110214001:1.source_cn: 欢迎欢迎！几位要来点什么？

say:2:1110214002:1.text: It's strange to find the Adamant Syndicate here in the Ashen Wastes.
say:2:1110214002:1.source_cn: 你们黑金商会的商人居然来了荒角沙漠，真是奇怪。

say:3:1110214003:1.text: The Warsong Festival is a grand event for the Mauler clans. Wherever there are customers, there is money to be made!
say:3:1110214003:1.source_cn: 战歌节可是蛮血的盛会，有人的地方，就有钱赚！

say:4:1110214004:1.text: And let me tell you, I really made a lot of money from this trip! Since you knew right away that I'm a member of the Adamant Syndicate, you must know we carry top-notch items.
say:4:1110214004:1.source_cn: 只跟您说，我来这一趟确实赚头不小！既然您知道我们黑金商...
say:4:1110214004:1.male: And let me tell you, I really made a lot of money from this trip! Since you knew right away that I'm a member of the Adamant Syndicate, you must know we carry top-notch items.
say:4:1110214004:1.female: And let me tell you, I really made a lot of money from this trip! Since you knew right away that I'm a member of the Adamant Syndicate, you must know we carry top-notch items.

say:5:1110214005:1.text: Any of my merchandise catch your eye?
say:5:1110214005:1.source_cn: 这桌上的特色商品，有没有能入眼的？
say:5:1110214005:1.male: Any of my merchandise catch your eye?
say:5:1110214005:1.female: Any of my merchandise catch your eye?

choice_prompt:6:1110214005.text: Any of my merchandise catch your eye?
choice_prompt:6:1110214005.source_cn: 这桌上的特色商品，有没有能入眼的？
choice_prompt:6:1110214005.male: Any of my merchandise catch your eye?
choice_prompt:6:1110214005.female: Any of my merchandise catch your eye?

say:7:1110214006:1.text: Yes, I understand. My merchandise is from the empire. The Maulers love them, but of course, you're used to goods like these.
say:7:1110214006:1.source_cn: 也是，这可是耀光来的货物，本地蛮血更喜欢。您自然见惯了。
say:7:1110214006:1.male: Yes, I understand. My merchandise is from the empire. The Maulers love them, but of course, you're used to goods like these.
say:7:1110214006:1.female: Yes, I understand. My merchandise is from the empire. The Maulers love them, but of course, you're used to goods like these.

say:8:1110214007:1.text: If you have other needs, feel free to come and find me!
say:8:1110214007:1.source_cn: 不过没关系，您要是有别的需求，随时来看！
say:8:1110214007:1.male: If you have other needs, feel free to come and find me!
say:8:1110214007:1.female: If you have other needs, feel free to come and find me!

say:0:1110215001:0.text: There doesn't seem to be anything suspicious about this person...
say:0:1110215001:0.source_cn: 目前看来，这人似乎没什么可疑的地方……

say:1:1110215002:0.text: We can't be too careful. What if that fake Merlin is somehow related to the Syndicate?
say:1:1110215002:0.source_cn: 还是不能掉以轻心！万一那个假梅林跟黑金商会有关怎么办？
say:1:1110215002:0.male: We can't be too careful. What if that fake Merlin is somehow related to the Syndicate?
say:1:1110215002:0.female: We can't be too careful. What if that fake Merlin is somehow related to the Syndicate?

say:2:1110215003:0.text: Let's meet up with the others first.
say:2:1110215003:0.source_cn: 现在多想无益，先跟阿尔萨他们会合吧。
say:2:1110215003:0.male: Let's meet up with the others first.
say:2:1110215003:0.female: Let's meet up with the others first.

say:2:1110216002:1.text: Those who look down on the Uru Clan think they're tough because they have more members...
say:2:1110216002:1.source_cn: 那些看不起乌尔氏族的家伙，只不过仗着人多势众而已……

say:3:1110216003:1.text: Alright, calm down. After talking to them for a bit, they told us how to participate in the trial, didn't they?
say:3:1110216003:1.source_cn: 行啦行啦！好好沟通之后，他们不也告诉我们参加试炼的方法了吗？

say:4:1110216004:0.text: As long as we register and pass the three trials, we'll be qualified to participate in the Warsong Festival on behalf of the Uru Clan.
say:4:1110216004:0.source_cn: 只要报名后，通过三次试炼，咱们就能代表乌尔氏族获得参加...

say:5:1110216005:1.text: That's right. The outcome of these three trials will determine whether or not we can honor our promise to our father and make a name for our clan at Mars Peak.
say:5:1110216005:1.source_cn: 没错——能否完成与老爹的约定，在战神峰打响氏族之名，全...

choice_prompt:6:1110216005.text: That's right. The outcome of these three trials will determine whether or not we can honor our promise to our father and make a name for our clan at Mars Peak.
choice_prompt:6:1110216005.source_cn: 没错——能否完成与老爹的约定，在战神峰打响氏族之名，全都取决于这三次试炼的结果。

say:8:1110216006:1.text: That's right! We found out that Magister Merlin will also be at Mars Peak. Since we're going to the same place, let's work together along the way!
say:8:1110216006:1.source_cn: 没错！我们打听到，梅林现在也在战神峰。既然目的地相同，...
say:8:1110216006:1.male: That's right! We found out that Magister Merlin will also be at Mars Peak. Since we're going to the same place, let's work together along the way!
say:8:1110216006:1.female: That's right! We found out that Magister Merlin will also be at Mars Peak. Since we're going to the same place, let's work together along the way!

say:9:1110216008:1.text: Yes, let's work together! I'm all about working together!
say:9:1110216008:1.source_cn: 齐心协力！好耶，我最喜欢这个词了！

say:11:1110216010:0.text: Refusing help... Soren, you wouldn't be so rude, would you?
say:11:1110216010:0.source_cn: 要拒绝帮手……索恩，你不会这么不上道吧？

say:12:1110216011:1.text: Did I say I would refuse? I just want to show everyone that the Uru Clan is not weak.
say:12:1110216011:1.source_cn: 我可没那么说——得让那些人看看，乌尔氏族可不是势单力薄。

say:13:1110216012:1.text: Thank you so much, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! With you helping the Uru Clan, we can face the first trial with confidence!
say:13:1110216012:1.male: Thank you so much, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! With you helping the Uru Clan, we can face the first trial with confidence!
say:13:1110216012:1.female: Thank you so much, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! With you helping the Uru Clan, we can face the first trial with confidence!

choice:6:0:1.text: We're also going to Mars Peak.
choice:6:0:1.male: We're also going to Mars Peak.
choice:6:0:1.female: We're also going to Mars Peak.

say:16:1110216007:1.text: Yes! We also need to go to Mars Peak to find Magister Merlin. Since we're going to the same place, let's go together!
say:16:1110216007:1.source_cn: 是啊！我们也要去战神峰找梅林。既然同路而行，我们一路上...
say:16:1110216007:1.male: Yes! We also need to go to Mars Peak to find Magister Merlin. Since we're going to the same place, let's go together!
say:16:1110216007:1.female: Yes! We also need to go to Mars Peak to find Magister Merlin. Since we're going to the same place, let's go together!

say:0:1110216101:0.text: Quick! Let's go register for the first trial!
say:0:1110216101:0.source_cn: 试炼领取处在那边！我们快过去吧！

say:1:1110217001:1.text: Hey, friends! Mikola would like to announce that the registration for the first trial of the Warsong Festival is about to end!
say:1:1110217001:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉的老朋友们，战歌节初赛第一道试炼领取时间，即将截止！

say:4:1110217003:1.text: Wait! The Uru Clan wants to participate in the first trial!
say:4:1110217003:1.source_cn: 等一等！乌尔氏族想要领取试炼！

say:5:1110217004:2.text: Oh! It's rare to see such energetic younglings! Uru Clan... the name doesn't ring a bell!
say:5:1110217004:2.source_cn: 哦！曼卡拉可是很少见到这么精神的毛团呢！乌尔氏族……这...

say:6:1110217005:1.text: Make sure you remember it from now on.
say:6:1110217005:1.source_cn: 你可以从现在开始记住这个名字。

say:7:1110217006:1.text: Ha! You little ones sure are confident!
say:7:1110217006:1.source_cn: 哈哈！乌尔氏族的年轻代表很有自信呢！曼卡拉觉得他值得大...

say:8:1110217007:1.text: Although your confidence is commendable, faith alone may not be enough to overcome the Trial of Blood.
say:8:1110217007:1.source_cn: 两位有信心自然是好，但“血之试炼”，可不是只靠信心就能...

say:9:1110217008:1.text: Trial of Blood? The first trial sounds scary...
say:9:1110217008:1.source_cn: “血之试炼”？第一道试炼听起来就这么可怕……

say:10:1110217009:1.text: Does it sound scary...? It's just a matter of going to an ominous place, facing wild and dangerous beasts, and stealing some treasures. That's all!
say:10:1110217009:1.source_cn: 哎呀呀，听起来很可怕吗？没关系，只不过是需要前去不祥之...

choice_prompt:11:1110217009.text: Does it sound scary...? It's just a matter of going to an ominous place, facing wild and dangerous beasts, and stealing some treasures. That's all!
choice_prompt:11:1110217009.source_cn: 哎呀呀，听起来很可怕吗？没关系，只不过是需要前去不祥之险地，面对莫测之凶兽，掠取其视若珍宝之物，仅此而已！

say:12:1110217010:1.text: Just hearing that, I want to curl myself up in a ball!
say:12:1110217010:1.source_cn: 光是用听的我已经想把自己团起来了！

say:13:1110217011:1.text: Now come on, stand beside Mikola and introduce yourselves.
say:13:1110217011:1.source_cn: 嗯哼！那么请我身边这两位来自乌尔氏族的勇士——

say:16:1110217014:1.text: Soren and Alsa, members of the Uru Clan! Welcome to the <style="highlight">Trial of Blood</style>. Let us begin the Warsong Festival!
say:16:1110217014:1.source_cn: 索恩和阿尔萨！欢迎你们代表乌尔氏族，迎接你们的<sty...

say:17:1110217015:1.text: Please listen carefully! The Trial of Blood will not be easy...

say:18:1110217016:1.text: On the night of the new moon, the warriors must go to the Spider Wasteland, retrieve a spider egg, and bring it to me!
say:18:1110217016:1.source_cn: 在新月之夜，赶赴赤沙蛛域的蜘蛛巢穴，将里面的蜘蛛蛋交给我！

say:19:1110217017:1.text: Sand spiders?! Our pops told us to never go in their territory. They say the sand there is dyed red with blood...
say:19:1110217017:1.source_cn: 赤沙蛛域！我听老爹讲过！那里是盘踞着巨大蜘蛛的凶险之地...

say:20:1110217018:2.text: We cannot take this lightly. Night of the new moon... That's two days from now.
say:20:1110217018:2.source_cn: 不能掉以轻心。新月之夜……那应该是两天后，对吧？

say:21:1110217019:1.text: Indeed! In the early morning, two days from now, there will be a send-off for all of you brave warriors!
say:21:1110217019:1.source_cn: 没错！我会在两天后的清晨为勇者们送行的！

say:22:1110217020:1.text: Use this time to prepare wisely, kiddos. Don't blame Mikola for not warning you.
say:22:1110217020:1.source_cn: 利用这段时间做足准备吧！可别怪曼卡拉没提醒诸位！

say:0:1110218001:0.text: I need to build up my strength then. Oh, I need to find something nutritious to eat!
say:0:1110218001:0.source_cn: 这两天要养足体力，吃好睡好……得去找点有营养的东西吃！

say:1:1110218002:0.text: The supplies needed for the trial must also be prepared in advance.
say:1:1110218002:0.source_cn: 嗯，战斗需要的物资，也要提前筹备。

say:2:1110218003:0.text: Let's check out the market nearby.
say:2:1110218003:0.source_cn: 在武斗场的市场中筹备一番吧。
say:2:1110218003:0.male: Let's check out the market nearby.
say:2:1110218003:0.female: Let's check out the market nearby.

say:1:1110220001:1.text: Friends of Mikola! Tonight, the new moon will hang high over the sand spiders' lair. Our warriors are ready to face the Trial of Blood!
say:1:1110220001:1.source_cn: 曼卡拉的老朋友们——今夜，新月将高悬赤沙蛛域上空！而我...

say:2:1110220002:1.text: They will need to find the Sand Spider Nest and bring back a spider egg to immortalize their victory at the Sunseek Arena!
say:2:1110220002:1.source_cn: 他们将勇闯赤沙蛛域，将象征胜利的蜘蛛蛋带回残阳武斗场！

say:3:1110220003:1.text: Let glory shine upon the first trial of the Warsong Festival! Let us look forward to their triumph!
say:3:1110220003:1.source_cn: 战歌节前的试炼荣耀开场！让我们期待他们的凯旋！

say:6:1110220005:1.text: You're holding my arm a little tight, Soren! Are you nervous?
say:6:1110220005:1.source_cn: 好紧！索恩，干嘛紧紧抓着我的胳膊？难道你……紧张了？

say:7:1110220006:1.text: You're the one who's nervous... I'm holding on to you so that you don't bury yourself in the sand.
say:7:1110220006:1.source_cn: 是你在紧张……我抓住你，为了免得你把自己埋进沙子里。

choice_prompt:8:1110220006.text: You're the one who's nervous... I'm holding on to you so that you don't bury yourself in the sand.
choice_prompt:8:1110220006.source_cn: 是你在紧张……我抓住你，为了免得你把自己埋进沙子里。

say:9:1110220007:1.text: I wouldn't do something that embarrassing in front of Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>...
say:9:1110220007:1.male: I wouldn't do something that embarrassing in front of Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>...
say:9:1110220007:1.female: I wouldn't do something that embarrassing in front of Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>...

say:10:1110220008:1.text: Let's go get some spider eggs and finish this quick!
say:10:1110220008:1.source_cn: 走吧走吧，快点取到蜘蛛蛋，就能快点结束！

say:11:1110220009:1.text: Stay safe! Can't wait to hear all the good news when you're back!
say:11:1110220009:1.source_cn: 注意安全！我就在残阳武斗场等着诸位的好消息啦！

say:0:1110221001:0.text: As we get closer, the sand will get redder. There'll also be a lot of skeletons...
say:0:1110221001:0.source_cn: 这条路上，离赤沙蛛域越近，沙子就越红。沿途还有不少骸骨……

say:1:1110221002:0.text: We'll also need to be careful of sandstorms, Alsa.
say:1:1110221002:0.source_cn: 从附近地貌的痕迹判断——阿尔萨，小心沙暴。

say:2:1110221003:0.text: Don't worry. I'm the best at finding shelter when there's a sandstorm!
say:2:1110221003:0.source_cn: 放心吧，我可是最擅长带着大家找地方躲避沙暴了！

say:0:1110222001:0.text: There's a spider nest ahead... This is going too well.
say:0:1110222001:0.source_cn: 前面就是蜘蛛巢穴了吧……是不是有些顺利过头了？

say:1:1110222002:0.text: I hear a noise. Is that the sound of claws across the sand?
say:1:1110222002:0.source_cn: 好像有什么声音？似乎是爪子在沙地爬动的声音。
say:1:1110222002:0.male: I hear a noise. Is that the sound of claws across the sand?
say:1:1110222002:0.female: I hear a noise. Is that the sound of claws across the sand?

say:0:1110223001:0.text: No wonder this place is a known territory of the sand spiders. They're everywhere...
say:0:1110223001:0.source_cn: 哇哇，蜘蛛也太多了，怪不得这里叫赤沙蛛域呢……

say:1:1110223002:0.text: Being surrounded by so many spiders is so flaming scary!
say:1:1110223002:0.source_cn: 被一群蜘蛛吃掉，总感觉很恐怖呢！

say:2:1110223003:0.text: ... Let's go. We need to find some spider eggs.

say:0:1110224001:0.text: Let's get rid of these and go find some spider eggs!
say:0:1110224001:0.source_cn: 解决这一波就快去取蛋吧！

say:1:1110224002:0.text: I didn't expect these spiders to be so difficult to deal with. There are so many of them!
say:1:1110224002:0.source_cn: 没想到蜘蛛们这么难缠，数量还这么多……

say:0:1110225001:0.text: We just need to take a spider egg from this nest, right?
say:0:1110225001:0.source_cn: 呼，只要从这里把蜘蛛蛋拿走就好了吧？

say:1:1110229001:1.text: I think I bumped into something with fur in the sandstorm just now...
say:1:1110229001:1.source_cn: 刚才在沙暴中，好像撞到了什么硬邦邦毛茸茸的东西……

choice_prompt:2:1110229001.text: I think I bumped into something with fur in the sandstorm just now...
choice_prompt:2:1110229001.source_cn: 刚才在沙暴中，好像撞到了什么硬邦邦毛茸茸的东西……

say:3:1110229002:1.text: A spider?! I'm glad I didn't open my eyes.
say:3:1110229002:1.source_cn: 蜘蛛！幸好萨忒娜没睁开眼睛细看！

say:4:1110229003:1.text: Why are you here? Are you also here for the trial?
say:4:1110229003:1.source_cn: 你怎么会在这里？也是来进行试炼的吗？

say:5:1110229004:1.text: No, it's because of the sandstorm that I'm here by chance...
say:5:1110229004:1.source_cn: 并非如此。唉，我被沙暴卷到这里纯属偶然……

say:6:1110229005:1.text: I was following the Crystal Ignis, but I didn't realize it would lead me into a lair of spiders.
say:6:1110229005:1.source_cn: 明明是跟随了炎晶之眼的指引，没想到却踏进了这都是蜘蛛的...

say:8:1110229007:1.text: There is someone I must find. The Crystal Ignis guided me here... This must mean that our fates are intertwined somehow.
say:8:1110229007:1.source_cn: 嗯，我有一定要找到的人。任凭炎晶之眼把我指引到了这里…...

say:9:1110229008:1.text: Let me try a divination. I'm quite skilled at reading fortunes. Maybe I can see into your future, and it might just help me figure out mine too.
say:9:1110229008:1.source_cn: 那么请让我为你们进行占卜吧！萨忒娜是个很厉害的占卜师，...

say:10:1110229009:1.text: I've never received a divination before. What do I need to do? Should I close my eyes?
say:10:1110229009:1.source_cn: 还没有人给我占卜过，我要做些什么？要闭上眼睛吗？还是……

say:11:1110229010:2.text: Let's start with you, the mage who saved me. Let me see into your past.
say:11:1110229010:2.source_cn: ——先从您开始吧，刚才施法救了我的魔法师！让我看看你的过去？
say:11:1110229010:2.male: Let's start with you, the mage who saved me. Let me see into your past.
say:11:1110229010:2.female: Let's start with you, the mage who saved me. Let me see into your past.

choice_prompt:12:1110229010.text: Let's start with you, the mage who saved me. Let me see into your past.
choice_prompt:12:1110229010.source_cn: ——先从您开始吧，刚才施法救了我的魔法师！让我看看你的过去？
choice_prompt:12:1110229010.male: Let's start with you, the mage who saved me. Let me see into your past.
choice_prompt:12:1110229010.female: Let's start with you, the mage who saved me. Let me see into your past.

say:13:1110229011:2.text: Please look into my eyes. In the stream of time, we divine, past the worldly veil we shine. Through spiritual eyes, clear and bright, we see beyond the shroud of night
say:13:1110229011:2.source_cn: 请看着我的眼睛。灵视之眼，上溯那不被世俗遮蔽的时光之流...
say:13:1110229011:2.male: Please look into my eyes. In the stream of time, we divine, past the worldly veil we shine. Through spiritual eyes, clear and bright, we see beyond the shroud of night
say:13:1110229011:2.female: Please look into my eyes. In the stream of time, we divine, past the worldly veil we shine. Through spiritual eyes, clear and bright, we see beyond the shroud of night

say:14:1110229012:1.text: What? This shouldn't be... I didn't see anything!
say:14:1110229012:1.source_cn: 不对！不应该是这样的……为什么……我什么都没看到！
say:14:1110229012:1.male: What? This shouldn't be... I didn't see anything!
say:14:1110229012:1.female: What? This shouldn't be... I didn't see anything!

choice_prompt:15:1110229012.text: What? This shouldn't be... I didn't see anything!
choice_prompt:15:1110229012.source_cn: 不对！不应该是这样的……为什么……我什么都没看到！
choice_prompt:15:1110229012.male: What? This shouldn't be... I didn't see anything!
choice_prompt:15:1110229012.female: What? This shouldn't be... I didn't see anything!

say:16:1110229013:1.text: This has never happened before! My spiritual sight has never failed me!
say:16:1110229013:1.source_cn: 什么？我的灵视居然什么没……不不不，从来没发生过这种事！
say:16:1110229013:1.male: This has never happened before! My spiritual sight has never failed me!
say:16:1110229013:1.female: This has never happened before! My spiritual sight has never failed me!

say:18:1110229014:1.text: You can't see the magister's past? This lady is a charlatan!
say:18:1110229014:1.source_cn: 没有看到主人的过去，不会是骗子吧？
say:18:1110229014:1.male: You can't see the magister's past? This lady is a charlatan!
say:18:1110229014:1.female: You can't see the magister's past? This lady is a charlatan!

say:19:1110229015:1.text: No, she's not. Because of this, I think she actually has some talent.
say:19:1110229015:1.source_cn: 不，正因如此，我反倒觉得这位占卜师没准有点天赋……

say:21:1110229017:1.text: I must be really worn out. That's the only explanation I can come up with. Yeah, that's gotta be it.
say:21:1110229017:1.source_cn: 嗯，一定是我太疲惫了！一定是这样！

say:22:1110229018:1.text: Let's just forget about what just happened. I'm actually more skilled at prophecy than divination.
say:22:1110229018:1.source_cn: 没关系！刚才的插曲请大家忘掉！其实比起占卜，我更擅长的...

say:25:1110229021:1.text: Hey! Don't give me that look! Just give me another shot to show what I can do, okay?
say:25:1110229021:1.source_cn: 两位这躲闪的眼神是怎么回事！再给我一次机会，证明我的实...

say:26:1110229022:1.text: Here, give me your hands! I see...
say:26:1110229022:1.source_cn: 来，两位请把手给我！我……看见……

say:27:1110229023:0.text: On the high peak where eagles soar... sleeps the eternal will... the summit is drenched in blood... the stranger hides in darkness...
say:27:1110229023:0.source_cn: 雄鹰盘旋的高高山峰之上，沉睡着永恒的意志……鲜血浇灌的...

say:28:1110229024:0.text: The bond of siblings... life and death, honor and strength are revealed in the thunder...
say:28:1110229024:0.source_cn: 双生的羁绊……生与死，荣誉与力量，在落雷中昭示……

say:29:1110229025:1.text: The high peak and the summit? Does that refer to Mars Peak?

say:30:1110229026:1.text: And also the blood... who's blood?

say:31:1110229027:1.text: Whew... Sorry, I think I spaced out for a second. I'll prepare to give you your prophecy now.

choice_prompt:32:1110229027.text: Whew... Sorry, I think I spaced out for a second. I'll prepare to give you your prophecy now.

say:33:1110229028:1.text: What?! Really?! I don't recall anything... Could one of the gods have spoken through me?
say:33:1110229028:1.source_cn: 什么？！我……什么都没说啊？莫非是我接收到了神灵的意旨吗？

say:34:1110229029:1.text: It seems that my spiritual power has gotten stronger. This time, I have a hunch that I'll see her again!
say:34:1110229029:1.source_cn: 看来我的灵力更强了！这次我有预感，我很快就能再见到她了！

say:35:1110229030:1.text: Alright, everyone. Farewell! I'm sure we will meet again under the setting sun.
say:35:1110229030:1.source_cn: 事不宜迟，萨忒娜向各位道别。无需远送，残阳映照下，我们...

say:37:1110229016:1.text: This feels odd. Maybe it's because I'm exhausted from the sandstorm, and my spiritual abilities are weakened.
say:37:1110229016:1.source_cn: 好奇怪？或许是因为我在沙暴中太过疲惫，灵力有点不足了吧。

choice:2:1:2.text: What do you think it was?
choice:2:1:2.male: What do you think it was?
choice:2:1:2.female: What do you think it was?

say:1:1110230002:0.text: Let's focus on our quest. We have the spider egg. Let's head back to the Sunseek Arena.
say:1:1110230002:0.source_cn: 不管她，既然已经取得蜘蛛蛋，我们尽快赶回残阳武斗场吧。

cinematic_dialogue:1:1110231001:.text: Oh, what a shame! That's really unfortunate!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1110231001:.source_cn: 遗憾！遗憾至极！运气真不错。
cinematic_dialogue:1:1110231001:.male: Oh, what a shame! That's really unfortunate!
cinematic_dialogue:1:1110231001:.female: Oh, what a shame! That's really unfortunate!

cinematic_dialogue:1:1110231002:.text: Well, I wasn't expecting much from this little trial anyway...
cinematic_dialogue:1:1110231002:.source_cn: 虽然也没指望小小的试炼能做什么……
cinematic_dialogue:1:1110231002:.male: Well, I wasn't expecting much from this little trial anyway...
cinematic_dialogue:1:1110231002:.female: Well, I wasn't expecting much from this little trial anyway...
